Every line starts after the prior line's end timestamp (no overlapping start times), so there are no true interruptions despite the confrontational tone; any sense of the second party cutting in is carried visually/off-mic rather than in the transcribed speech.
speech_rhythm_notes: Gaps between lines shrink and then stretch to set up the punchline: line 2 and line 3 are both only 5 words and follow short gaps (0.19s and 0s respectively), giving a rapid, clipped back-and-forth rhythm in the middle of the clip. The final line is both the longest (15 words) and follows the longest between-line pause in the clip (0.81s, the 7.32-8.13s silence window), so the biggest pause directly precedes the biggest/most damning line, giving it a deliberate beat of tension before the reveal. Several silence windows (1.59-1.75s, 2.10-2.37s inside line 1; 6.52-6.91s inside line 3; 10.02-10.34s inside line 4) fall inside individual lines rather than between them, producing a halting, mid-sentence cadence within the dialogue itself rather than only at scene boundaries; the clip also opens with a 1.02s pre-roll silence and closes with a 2.65s silence tail after the last line.
